title: Implement production data-source architecture and optional remote API adapter
description: Implement the production data-source boundary for the mobile app. Static informational content (bootstrap defaults, menu, about, contact, and external links) MUST have a bundled, approved production provider so the release app does not depend on an unavailable first-party API. Also implement an optional remote JSON API adapter matching specs/API_CONTRACT.md so a first-party service can override/update bundled content later. Truck schedules remain a separate dynamic concern. Never scrape website HTML from the mobile runtime.
acceptance_criteria:
- Release builds can render bootstrap defaults, Menu, About, Contact, and More with the remote API completely unavailable.
- Bundled production content is stored separately from development/test fixtures and is not labeled or treated as mock data.
- Repository interfaces allow an optional remote JSON provider to override bundled static content when configured and valid.
- Remote absence, 404, timeout, or malformed optional static response falls back to bundled production content without blocking the screen.
- The remote adapter supports the structured bootstrap/menu/about contract in specs/API_CONTRACT.md when a service becomes available.
- No runtime mobile HTML scraping, WebView content extraction, or traversal of ordering-provider pages exists.
notes: Architecture correction: the original bead incorrectly assumed access to an existing first-party backend and made that assumption a release blocker. Static informational screens must not depend on it.

title: Add bundled production content plus deterministic development fixtures
description: Create two explicitly separate data sets: (1) approved bundled production content used by release builds for bootstrap/menu/about/contact/external-link defaults, and (2) deterministic development/test fixtures used for edge cases and mocked schedule scenarios. Both must pass through the same domain validation.
acceptance_criteria:
- Bundled production content contains approved bootstrap defaults, Menu, About, Contact, and More-link configuration.
- Development/test fixtures are stored separately and cannot silently replace production content in release builds.
- Release builds can render Home static sections, Menu, About, More, and Contact with networking disabled.
- Fixture and bundled production payloads run through the same validation layer as remote responses.
- README documents the difference between production bundled content and mock/test fixtures.
notes: Do not use the word 'fixture' for data that is intentionally shipped as authoritative production fallback content.

title: Implement repositories, optional remote client, cache, and refresh policy
description: Implement typed repositories for bootstrap, menu, about, links, states, and events. Static repositories must always have a bundled production source and may optionally layer a remote JSON source over it. Dynamic schedule repositories may use configured remote data when available and deterministic data in development/tests. Add cache validators, cancellation, timeout/retry policy, persisted last-successful cache, and source/last-updated metadata.
acceptance_criteria:
- Menu/About/bootstrap/link repositories return valid bundled production content when no API base URL is configured.
- Configured remote static content can override bundled content only after successful validation.
- Failure of an optional remote static source never converts valid bundled production content into an error state.
- Successful remote event/menu/about/bootstrap responses can be restored after app restart.
- Transient failures do not delete last-known-good remote cache.
- The repository exposes data provenance (bundled, cache, remote, test) for diagnostics/tests without exposing it as customer-facing debug UI.
- No raw location coordinates or sensitive URL query values are logged.
notes: This bead must be completable without oth-mobile.6 deploying a live server.

title: Build polished Home screen
description: Implement Home according to specs/DESIGN.md: branded hero, primary Find a Truck CTA, Coming Near You cards, three brand-story cards, and notification CTA. Static brand/content sections use bundled production content with optional validated remote overrides; event cards use the schedule repository.
acceptance_criteria:
- Hero and brand-story content render in a release build with the remote bootstrap/content API disabled.
- Hero uses approved On The Hook branding and packaged photography without obscuring readable text.
- Find a Truck CTA navigates to Find Us and does not force a permission prompt.
- Coming Near You shows up to 3 relevant events when schedule data exists or a clear choose-area/search/unavailable prompt when it does not.
- Brand-story cards cover Line Caught, Hand Battered, and Secret-Recipe Sauces from production content.
- Set Up Alerts navigates to notification onboarding when that capability is enabled.
- Home distinguishes static-content availability from live-schedule availability; a missing schedule service does not blank the whole screen.

title: Build Menu screen
description: Implement the informational Menu screen with sticky/accessible category navigation for Entrees, Sides, and Drinks. The production path uses approved bundled menu content; a validated remote menu response may override it when configured.
acceptance_criteria:
- Release build renders the complete approved menu with networking and API base URL disabled.
- All menu items/content in specs/CONTENT.md are represented through bundled production data.
- A valid remote menu response may override bundled content; remote failure falls back without blocking the screen.
- Category selection is keyboard/screen-reader accessible and scroll position behaves predictably.
- Prices are not fabricated; null price renders no price.
- Menu can be opened from the bottom tab and Event Detail preview.

title: Build About screen
description: Implement the visual About story from approved bundled production content and packaged assets: sea-to-table hero, scale statements, line-caught benefits, Two Oceans One Standard, sauces, hand-battered, secret-recipe batter, and closing community statement. Optional validated remote content may override bundled copy.
acceptance_criteria:
- Release build renders the full About screen with networking and API base URL disabled.
- Sections follow specs/DESIGN.md and CONTENT.md without raw website HTML blobs.
- Optional remote About data can override bundled production content only after validation.
- Photography is cropped responsively and includes appropriate accessible treatment.
- Claims are limited to approved first-party content.
- Screen remains readable at large Dynamic Type sizes.

title: Build Contact screen and call/email actions
description: Implement a native Contact screen using bundled production contact values with optional validated remote bootstrap overrides. Provide tap-to-email and tap-to-call actions, but do not automatically launch either action.
acceptance_criteria:
- Release build displays the approved contact email/phone with the remote API disabled.
- Displays info@onthehookfishandchips.com and 307-316-4665 when bundled production defaults are used.
- Email Us opens a mail composer/mail handler using mailto only after explicit tap.
- Call Us opens tel only after explicit tap.
- Invalid/missing remote bootstrap values fall back to bundled production values.
- Contact details are selectable/copyable where practical.

title: Implement external Jobs Store Franchise and legal destinations
description: Wire approved bundled production destinations for Jobs, Store, Franchise, Privacy Policy, and Terms, with optional validated remote bootstrap overrides. Keep job application and commerce/franchise experiences on their existing external web destinations.
acceptance_criteria:
- Release build has valid Jobs, Store, Franchise, Privacy, and Terms destinations with remote bootstrap disabled.
- URLs come from a centralized production-content/config provider, not scattered literals.
- Valid remote bootstrap values may override bundled defaults; invalid/missing remote values do not remove required links.
- External destinations use the centralized safe external-link service.
- No ordering/vendor links are traversed while implementing these destinations.

title: Implement offline and stale-data experience
description: Persist last-known-good remote dynamic data and expose clear stale/offline states. Bundled production Menu/About/bootstrap/link content remains available offline by design; cached schedule data remains available when valid and not misleadingly expired.
acceptance_criteria:
- Bundled production Menu/About/bootstrap/link content works after process death/relaunch with no network.
- Cached remote data survives process death/relaunch.
- Offline banner shows last-updated time for dynamic/cached resources where meaningful.
- Refresh failures keep last-known-good dynamic content visible.
- Expired events are not misleadingly presented as upcoming solely because they exist in old cache.
- External actions remain explicit and show errors if the OS/network cannot open them.

title: Implement comprehensive loading error and empty states
description: Standardize feature-level states for first load, background refresh, no upcoming events, no filter matches, location denied, notification denied, dynamic-source unavailable, network error, malformed remote response, and stale cached content. A missing optional static-content API is not an error when bundled production content is valid.
acceptance_criteria:
- Home, Find Us, Menu, About, More/Contact, and settings screens use consistent reusable state components.
- Menu/About/More do not show an error merely because no first-party bootstrap/content API exists.
- Retry actions retry only applicable remote/dynamic resources without resetting unrelated filters.
- No raw exception/stack trace is shown to customers.
- Empty states give a useful next action rather than a blank screen.
- Component tests cover primary state variants.

title: Add component and feature integration tests
description: Implement component and integration tests for all primary screens/components and important UX states. Tests must exercise the actual release-selected bundled production provider as well as mocked remote overrides/failures.
acceptance_criteria:
- TruckEventCard/MenuItemCard/BrandStoryCard controls are tested.
- Release-provider tests render Menu, About, More, and Contact with API/network disabled.
- Remote override and remote-failure-to-bundled-fallback behavior is tested for static content.
- Home renders static production content independently of schedule availability.
- Find Us search/filter/pagination and map/list selection are tested against deterministic schedule data.
- Event Detail conditional order action is tested.
- Notification onboarding granted/denied flows are tested without requiring real push infrastructure.

title: Add iOS and Android critical-flow E2E tests
description: Implement E2E coverage from TEST_PLAN.md using the repository-standard mobile E2E framework. Core informational flows MUST run against the release-selected bundled production content provider; dynamic schedule flows may use deterministic injected/staging data.
acceptance_criteria:
- Menu/About/More/Contact E2E paths pass with the first-party content/bootstrap API disabled.
- Find Us search -> event detail -> directions flow passes using deterministic or staging schedule data.
- Location denied -> manual search flow passes.
- Order Food test asserts external-link invocation only and never browses vendor content.
- Notification pre-permission flow passes for granted/denied variants without requiring live push delivery.
- Offline cached schedule flow passes.
- Critical suite runs on both iOS and Android in the documented environment.

title: Create operational and developer documentation
description: Integrate this package into repository docs and document local setup, bundled production content, test fixtures, optional remote API configuration, maps, APNs/FCM, app links, release build commands, and troubleshooting.
acceptance_criteria:
- New developer can launch release-like iOS/Android using bundled production informational content without a backend API.
- Bundled production content vs test fixture responsibilities are documented.
- Optional production/staging remote API configuration is documented separately from required static content.
- Maps/APNs/FCM configuration references secret locations without exposing values.
- Ordering scope explicitly states external handoff only.
- Asset replacement procedure for official logo is documented.
- Beads import/implementation assumptions are recorded.

title: Run release privacy and store-readiness review
description: Review the implemented app against Apple/Google privacy declarations, location/notification usage, external purchasing/order handoff, screenshots/metadata, brand assets, and release data-source configuration before beta submission.
acceptance_criteria:
- Privacy disclosures accurately describe the capabilities actually enabled in the release build.
- App does not claim or request background location.
- Ordering is clearly an external food-order handoff and does not create a hidden in-app checkout.
- Official logo/icon/splash assets are present.
- Release build uses bundled production informational content and cannot expose development fixtures.
- Absence of an optional bootstrap/menu/about API does not block release.
- Any capability that truly requires an unavailable backend (for example live server-driven push) is feature-flagged off or explicitly waived for that release rather than faked.

title: Execute final acceptance and signoff matrix
description: Perform the final end-to-end acceptance pass using specs/TEST_PLAN.md and the epic requirements. Acceptance must distinguish production-capable bundled informational content from optional remote services and genuinely backend-dependent capabilities.
acceptance_criteria:
- All child beads oth-mobile.1 through oth-mobile.43 are closed or explicitly waived with a documented reason.
- Critical E2E flows pass on iOS and Android for capabilities enabled in the release configuration.
- Home static content, Menu, About, More, and Contact are verified using the release-selected production provider with the first-party content/bootstrap API disabled.
- Find Us/Event Detail are verified against the configured schedule provider or deterministic release-gate substitute; absence of a separate bootstrap/content API is not a blocker.
- Directions, calendar, offline behavior, and external handoffs are verified.
- No native ordering/cart/checkout, account, loyalty, or runtime mobile HTML scraping exists.
- Release build contains official brand assets and cannot activate development fixtures.
- Backend-dependent capabilities not available for this release are explicitly feature-flagged/waived and are not presented as functional to customers.
- Final acceptance report is attached/linked in project docs.
notes: Final acceptance must not fail solely because a first-party bootstrap/menu/about API was never supplied. Those screens have an approved bundled production path.
